event_time.note: Fingrid records the EstLink 2 disconnection at 12:26 Finnish time (10:26 UTC). The former 12:30 UTC catalogue value has been corrected.

location.note: Approximate Gulf of Finland segment midpoint from incidents.csv; not a forensic contact coordinate.

vessel.name: Eagle S
vessel.association: Finnish investigators reconstructed an approximately 100 km seabed drag trace and recovered an anchor for examination in relation to Eagle S.

physical_cause.label: anchor_drag
physical_cause.basis: Finnish police reported an approximately 100 km seabed drag trace and an anchor recovered near the location where Eagle S was instructed to raise the anchor it had been dragging.

intent_assessment.label: not_finally_adjudicated
intent_assessment.basis: The district court ruling cited here was jurisdictional. It did not establish that the physical event was accidental or that prosecutors failed to prove intent on the merits.

legal_status.label: district_court_inadmissibility_ruling_under_appeal
legal_status.basis: The Helsinki District Court ruled the charges inadmissible on UNCLOS-related jurisdiction grounds on 3 October 2025. The Deputy Prosecutor General filed notice of appeal.

timeline.description: EstLink 2 disconnected from the grid; the fault was later located in the submarine cable.
Authorities recovered an approximately 11-ton anchor from the Gulf of Finland.
Police reported an approximately 100 km seabed drag trace and said the technical sequence was already quite clear.
Helsinki District Court ruled the charges inadmissible because Finnish criminal law could not be applied under UNCLOS-related jurisdiction restrictions.
The Deputy Prosecutor General announced an appeal to the Helsinki Court of Appeal.

evidence.finding: Underwater investigation identified an approximately 100 km drag trace.
Authorities recovered an approximately 4 m by 2.5 m, 11-ton anchor for forensic examination and identity confirmation.
EstLink 2 disconnected and the operator subsequently located the fault in the submarine cable.

ais_track.note: No validated incident vessel track is packaged in this dossier.

weather_sample.caveat: Open-Meteo model/reanalysis sample at the approximate incident midpoint; contextual only.

sentinel_catalogue.note: Catalogue availability only. The closest listed optical scene is highly cloud-covered.

demo_guidance.safe_summary: A high-consequence anchor-drag sequence associated with Eagle S damaged multiple cables. The later district-court dismissal concerned jurisdiction and is under appeal in the latest cited official update.
cueing_signals: long abnormal movement aligned with multiple cable crossings
weather context that may affect both causation analysis and sensor choice
SAR preferred when optical coverage is cloud-obscured
demo_guidance.do_not_say: Do not present the court ruling as proof that no harmful act occurred or as an acquittal on the factual merits.
